title: ID0407467-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001360] plug stucks when stopping a session
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On both the Sicharge D and the Dispencer, charging sessions are started successfully. However, there are issues when stopping a charging session. The plug then gets stuck with the customer, preventing the customer from leaving.
Root cause:
NA
Solution:
Docker reboot
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: Out of warranty since 12/7/2024

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407467-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001360] plug stucks when stopping a session CRM:00579001511
additional_info.body:
Hello Chloë,
Thanks for your response.
We apologize for the delay in responding to your concern about the charger plug remaining stuck in 'preparing' and 'finishing' modes, preventing the release of your electric vehicle. Our team is actively collaborating with experts to analyze the issue and will provide you with a detailed update as soon as possible.
In the meantime, if you haven't already, you might consider the following steps:
Manual Release Mechanism
: Many vehicles are equipped with a manual release mechanism for the charging connector. This is often located in the trunk or near the charging port. Refer to your vehicle's user manual for precise instructions.
Ensuring Proper Alignment
: Sometimes, the charging cable may not release due to misalignment. Supporting both the handle and the cable to ensure they align properly with the port can help initiate or terminate the charge successfully.
Because we checked logs and found-
Mon, 17 Feb 2025 18:38:40 GMT
2025-02-17, 18:38:39
2025-02-17T18:38:39.535317+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] ecog-secc-adapter/5fb6bf86b1ce[734]: {"type":"alert","timestamp":1739817520143,"chargerId":"secc2300-07916","outlet":"1","outletType":"CCS","payload":{"src":"stack","code":54,"msg":"ERR_
EVCOM, EV communication problem detected
"}}
Kindly allow us some time for further analysis.
We will inform you promptly as soon as there is any update from the experts.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut

Because we wanted to inform you that on February 27, 2025, we updated the docker of the charger. Following this update, we observed that Connector 1 was available in the logs.
Could you please confirm this from your end and let us know the current status of Connector 1?

Looking forward to your response.
